Hai Raaz-e-Hoo Isse Seene Mein Tham Kar Rakho

/bin/bash -lc "python - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
p = Path('src/data/lyrics/main-ali-ko-khuda-nahi-kehta.md')
_, metadata, body = p.read_text().split('---')
roman = metadata.split('romanLyrics: |-\\n')[1].splitlines()
source = body.strip().splitlines()
assert roman[0] == '  1' and source[0] == '۱'
assert len(roman) == len(source) == 5
assert [line.strip().lower() for line in roman[1:]] == [
    'hai raaz-e-hoo isse seene mein tham kar rakho',
    'agar ho mast-e-alastu iss ko barmala na kaho',
    'bas iss liye main ali koo khuda nahi kehta',
    'keh khud ali ne kaha mujhe khuda na kaho',
]
assert 'direction: \"rtl\"' in metadata and 'noUrdu' not in metadata
print(body.strip())
PY"
